mapper.select: SELECT dev_id AS "id",job_cd AS "jobCode",jncmp_dt AS "joinDate",retire_dt AS "retireDate" FROM tb_hr_dev WHERE use_yn='Y' AND drct_cls_cd='DRCT' ORDER BY dev_id
SELECT dev_id AS "developerId",bgn_dt AS "startDate",end_dt AS "endDate" FROM tb_hr_dev_stat WHERE work_stat_cd='LEAVE' ORDER BY dev_id,stat_sn
SELECT a.asgn_id AS "id",p.proj_stat_cd AS "projectStatus",p.ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id WHERE a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' ORDER BY a.asgn_id

SELECT n.job_cd AS "jobCode",n.bgn_ym AS "startMonth",n.prd_mcnt::integer AS "months", n.need_cnt::integer AS "count",n.mon_mm AS "monthlyMm",o.win_prbl_rt AS "probability" FROM tb_sl_opp_need n JOIN tb_sl_opp o ON o.opp_id=n.opp_id WHERE o.opp_stat_cd='ING' ORDER BY o.opp_id,n.need_sn
SELECT DISTINCT ON (std_cd) std_cd AS "code",std_val AS "value" FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY std_cd,aply_bgn_ym DESC
